title: Emotionless Speech Features V2.5
description: The format of the Data of a Speech Descriptors Object (MMC-SDO-V2.5): the JSON text of its inline Data, or of what its DataURI gives, with no Qualifier that carries the features of an emotionless speech segment: what Speech Feature Analysis 2 (CAE-SFB) gives Emotion Feature Production (CAE-EFP). It replaces SpeechDescriptors2 of CAE V2.1.
